test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means P is the mother of Q,

P - Q means P is the brother of Q,

P × Q means P is the wife of Q,

P / Q means P is the father of Q.

Based on the above, how is B related to D in A × B / C - D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34b738aa9f4d44f180bcd8434ab30fd8c01193aa5f20fb536de68443afb7433c.png] 

The family tree can be drawn using the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6572e623e983efcc68762b87481c2e5b226aa9e789d5fd257861167526961891.png] 

Here, we can see that B is the father of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Father"**.
